desc:
🏁 Build your dream car, master every drift, and dominate high-speed street races across busy city roads and open highways!

🏎️ RACE. DRIFT. DRIVE.
• Challenge friends and rivals in competitive street races
• Drift through corners, weave past traffic, and push your vehicle to its limits
• Cruise the city, explore the highways, or bring your crew to a car meet
• Earn cash, upgrade your cars, and build a garage worth showing off

🎨 MAKE EVERY CAR YOURS
• Create your own style with NEW LIVERIES
• Choose from 300+ colors and 60+ rims
• Customize headlights, camber, and much more
• Bring your cleanest vehicles to meets and show everyone your build

🔥 Your car. Your build. Your streets.
👑 Do you have what it takes to become a Street Legend?

⭐ Like + favorite for more cars and updates.
🚗 Join Assetto Studio for exclusive vehicles and update news.
